messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: REGION-FALLBACK-LOOP detected — elevated health check flaps across us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. 40% of route switches in last 5m. Escalate to on-call. (alert id: RF-2026-4872)

alice.m: grabbing this. seeing a sawtooth in routing — requests keep bouncing between regions, increased tail latency and 502s. pinging oncall.

ben_p: oncall here. joining. any immediate customer impact flagged?

support-bot: Alert matches support ticket #98712: "responses intermittent, many 502s" — customer: AcmeChat (enterprise). Approx 12% error rate from their org per dashboard.

carol: logs show health-check flapping for model-variants on us-east and us-west. Looks like the gateway policy is configured to fallback aggressively to nearest region then back to eu when probe returns.

alice.m: reproducing logs snippet:```
2026-03-15T02:07:12Z route:us-east -> model:v1-quant
2026-03-15T02:07:13Z health-check: us-east failed (timeout)
2026-03-15T02:07:13Z route:us-west -> model:v1-quant
2026-03-15T02:07:14Z health-check: us-west passed
2026-03-15T02:07:15Z route:eu -> model:v1-8bit
2026-03-15T02:07:16Z health-check: eu passed
2026-03-15T02:07:17Z route:us-east -> model:v1-quant
```

ben_p: looks like two problems: (1) fallback routing policy cycles when health checks are noisy, (2) model variant mismatch — eu is using v1-8bit which is compatible but has slower cold-starts causing transient failures.

dave_oncall: I see the routing policy:```
fallback_policy:
  - prefer: nearest
  - regions: [us-west, us-east, eu]
health_check:
  interval: 1s
  fail_threshold: 1
  recover_threshold: 1
```
Interval 1s + fail_threshold 1 will oscillate on small latency spikes. 

alice.m: agreed — that config will definitely create a loop. we should pause automatic fallback and raise fail_threshold while we stabilize.

ben_p: mitigation plan: 1) disable auto-fallback for impacted route 2) set health_check.interval=5s and fail_threshold=3 3) pin AcmeChat to us-west as an emergency measure 4) notify customers 5) follow-up postmortem. doing 1/2 now.

carol: running command to patch policy (prod routing control-plane):```
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.redwood.internal/v1/routes/route-abc/config \
  -d '{"health_check":{"interval":5,"fail_threshold":3,"recover_threshold":2},"auto_fallback":false}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

incident-bot: Change accepted, rollout id cr-3342 triggered. Rolling update to routing table.

ben_p: pinning AcmeChat: setting static_route for org-acme to us-west with max_retries=2. CLI: `ri routes pin --org acmechat --region us-west`

alice.m: quick check on metrics — errors for AcmeChat dropping from 12% -> 3% after pin. Other global error rate down ~60%. good initial sign.

dave_oncall: also noticed model variant mismatch: eu serving v1-8bit by default; that variant's coldstart serialization seems to have higher p99 mem usage and triggers preemption in eu zone during spikes. we should add variant compatibility check to fallback policy next.

carol: creating ACL rule to prevent fallback to eu for this route until we fix variants. `ri routes update route-abc --no-fallback eu` — applied.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers: message queued to AcmeChat and 3 other enterprise orgs. Template: "We're investigating intermittent errors, temporary routing changes applied."

ben_p: handover: I'm paged and will remain active for next 30m. if latency spikes again escalate to SRE lead. dave, can you take postmortem writeup?

dave_oncall: yep will own the postmortem. capturing timeline and RCA. early hypothesis: aggressive health_check settings + incompatible variant fallback caused sustained routing oscillation.

alice.m: adding runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-fallback-loop and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/fallback-policy-hardening — followup items: add jitter to health checks, minimum backoff before re-routing, variant-compatibility matrix, and circuit-breaker on route-switches.

carol: quick note: we also saw increased token cost due to repeated cold-starts while bouncing between variants; estimate extra cost ~ $1.2k last hour. include in customer impact section.

ben_p: final status (1901234967): mitigations in place, auto-fallback disabled, health checks damped, AcmeChat pinned. Monitoring for 30m. Paging to clear. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident RF-2026-4872 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Paging cleared at 02:22 UTC. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to dave_oncall, priority P2.

alice.m: thanks team. will follow up in #postmortems when draft ready.

carol: one-liner for ops channel: "Region fallback loops (us-east/us-west/eu) caused by aggressive health checks + variant fallbacks; temporary mitigations applied; postmortem incoming." :eyes:
